name: Bazaar of Tabriz
scope: The main connected historic market of Tabriz, including covered retail rows, timber shopfronts, characteristic domed halls and the mapped open caravanserais.
era: Standing historic market at UNESCO component 1346-001, with current native layout controls and estimates for historic roofs.

references.caption: An alley in Tabriz Bazaar in an Eid day (the flags are hanged due to the Eid day).
references.alt: An alley in Tabriz Bazaar in an Eid day (the flags are hanged due to the Eid day).

originalReview.notes: The historic bazaar alley is photographed beneath a sequence of high pointed brick cross-vaults, repeated pierced skylights, darker recessed stalls and stone at the lower edge. Used for masonry form and rhythm.

review.method: Exact Qualla original, national heritage nomination, open survey and original relief
review.notes: Used the exact Qualla-published original licensed by its photographer, with native upload and original bytes verified. Primary written heritage descriptions and native mapped controls govern roof heights, component placement and the footprint.
